title: HabitCult
tagline: A decentralized protocol to build/break habits using web3 incentives
description: [Full disclosure: The main protocol was developed in the Road2Web3 hackathon. In this Hackathon, I just experimented the integrating Skillwallet into our project to build a good DAO]. At HabitCult, our vision is to build a social credibility layer based on independent smaller communities. The main motivation for using skillwallet came from me thinking about how can we create a good community structure for our protocol while distributing any profit made by this protocol to early supporters. Skillwallet seemed like a good experiment to do in this direction.
how_its_made: Am not going to explain the previously build stuff. In this project, only Skill wallet has experimented with where I tested how skill wallet helps create roles, and tasks and generate non-transferable NFT IDs for our community members. At HabitCult, our vision is to build a social credibility layer based on independent smaller communities. It's extremely important to have a DAO structure to keep everyone's incentives aligned. Using Skill wallet, we create roles as L1 Community Managers and Level managers. Using this, we will be able to create tasks for these managers and if at all our protocol hypothesis works, we will be able to distribute their profits/tokens at a later stage to our early adopters. We will be doing the task management in our discord community: https://discord.gg/zB9ygvH6xU
